name: note_taker
description: Save a quick note, retrieve a specific note by ID, list all your notes, search your notes, update a note, delete a note (requires confirmation), or add a tag to a note.

action.description: save: create a note. get: retrieve one by ID. list: all your notes. search: find by title/content/tag. update: edit a note. delete: remove a note (needs confirmation). add_tag: tag an existing note.

content.description: Note body text. Required for save; optional for update.

title.description: Note title. Optional for save/update - auto-generated from timestamp if omitted on save.

tags.description: Tags for the note. Used for save/update.

note_id.description: The note's ID. Required for get, update, delete, add_tag.

tag.description: A single tag to add. Required for action='add_tag'.

limit.description: Max notes for list/search. Defaults to 50/20 respectively.

confirm.description: Must be explicitly true to actually delete a note.
